title: Reviewer Result v1
description: Stable Reviewer output contract of the Workflow Engine (Plan 7). The Reviewer's final reply must be exactly one JSON object matching this schema and nothing else: no Markdown fences, no explanations before or after the JSON. The Workflow Engine parses this JSON from Result Envelope.output_text and strictly validates the verdict; if a second fresh Reviewer session still produces an invalid result, the workflow becomes FAILED (REVIEW_RESULT_INVALID). Verdict semantics: PASS = accepted; FIX = target basically correct but local repairs needed; REWORK = structural rework needed, the original acceptance criteria must be re-checked (not a local patch).

schema_version.description: Result schema version. Fixed to 1 for Reviewer Result v1. Any breaking schema change must bump this value (see templates/AGENTS.md).

verdict.description: Final review verdict. PASS = accepted; FIX = target basically correct, local repair required; REWORK = structural rework required. Drives the Workflow Engine review loop: PASS advances the workflow, FIX/REWORK replay the review target node and its affected descendants up to max_rework_cycles.

summary.description: Short human-readable summary of this review round.

findings.description: Review findings. Defaults to an empty array (typical for a clean PASS). Each finding must state severity, file (nullable), reason and required_fix; the findings are appended to the rework task objective sent back to the executor.

file.description: File the finding refers to (path). Null when the finding is not tied to a specific file.

reason.description: Why this is a problem, judged against the original requirement and acceptance criteria.

required_fix.description: The fix the executor must apply to resolve this finding.
